name: phil/embed-bundle
description: Features of a Symfony site that other sites embed: a token signed for one origin by an ordered list of keys, its format and algorithm named in it; the page answered in the theme the token or the page asks for and framed by that origin alone through frame-ancestors, with phil/browser-security-bundle or a header of its own; a <phil-embed> element that holds the frame at the height its content asks for by a small postMessage protocol, the origin checked on both sides, and keeps a plain link for readers without JavaScript

suggest.phil/browser-security-bundle: To write frame-ancestors into the site's content security policy rather than in a header of the bundle's own
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To serve the frame controller without a build step
